scripts.validate:sitemap: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const xml=fs.readFileSync('sitemap.xml','utf8'); const parser=require('xmldom').DOMParser; const doc=new parser().parseFromString(xml,'text/xml'); const errors=doc.getElementsByTagName('parsererror'); if(errors.length) { console.error('XML Errors:', errors[0].textContent); process.exit(1); } console.log('Sitemap XML is valid'); const urls=doc.getElementsByTagName('url'); console.log('Total URLs:', urls.length);"
